name: Vorkath
dataSource: Monster statistics: OSRS Wiki via bundled monsters.json. Strategy notes: OSRS Wiki Vorkath/Strategies.
validationNotes: Single-phase fight. Dragon and undead bonuses (dragon hunter weapons, salve amulet) are covered by the reference validation tests.
warnings: Dragonfire protection is mandatory: a super antifire potion, or an anti-dragon shield / dragonfire shield / dragonfire ward plus an antifire potion.
Vorkath's venom dragonfire applies venom: bring anti-venom.
The zombified spawn is normally killed with Crumble Undead; the planner reserves runes for it.

strategies.name: Ranged
strategies.description: Crossbow or bow from a distance. Dragon hunter crossbow and salve amulet (ei) are evaluated automatically if owned.

inventory.reason: Ranged boost for the whole kill
Crumble Undead for the zombified spawn

strategies.name: Melee
strategies.description: Dragon hunter lance or other stab weapon in melee range. Vorkath's melee attack is added to the damage you take.

inventory.reason: Melee boost for the whole kill
Crumble Undead for the zombified spawn
